intent: The agent asks before it acts: risk, what will happen in words, an exact preview of the command or diff, and Approve (⌘/Ctrl+Enter) / Deny (Escape) with an optional auto-deny countdown.
useWhen: an agent needs a person's OK before a command, file edit, or other side effect
human-in-the-loop gates in a chat, trail, or inbox
a resolved decision should stay in the log as one line
inside AgentMonitor, as variant="compact" for the run's waiting state
compact inside AgentMonitor, with waitingSec, to say how long the agent has waited for the OK
doNotUseWhen: a generic yes/no that interrupts the page — AlertDialog
a recommendation the person may act on later — InsightCard
a plan of several steps to accept — AgentPlan

action.note: { kind: "command", command, note?, target? } or { kind: "diff", file, lines: { type: "context" | "add" | "remove", text }[] }. Shown exactly as it will run.

facts.note: { label, value }[], e.g. Will do / Why medium. What will happen and why the risk is what it is, in words, as a dl above the preview. The exact action still shows.

status.note: Anything but pending renders the one-line resolved row.

variant.note: compact is for AgentMonitor's waiting state only: one row with the title (and the countdown when countdownSec is set), one line of description, the exact preview and small right-aligned Deny and Approve. No risk Badge, heading or facts; the risk is read to screen readers with the title.

waitingSec.note: Compact only: seconds the agent has already waited for this OK, shown as "waiting m:ss" in the title row and counting up while pending. Hidden when left out; ignored by the default variant. Not a deadline: use countdownSec for auto-deny.

countdownSec.note: Auto-deny countdown in seconds. At 0 the card calls onExpire, else onDeny. Pending only.

onApprove.note: Approve button (Check icon) and ⌘/Ctrl+Enter while focus is in the card. Plain Enter never approves.

onDeny.note: Deny button and Escape while focus is in the card but not on another control.

onExpire.note: Countdown reached 0. Falls back to onDeny.

requirements: title is h3, article aria-labelledby it
facts are a dl, so each label is read as a term
⌘/Ctrl+Enter approves and Escape denies while focus is in the card (Escape not on another control); plain Enter never approves; buttons carry aria-keyshortcuts
the key hint line is aria-hidden and hidden on touch screens
countdown is role=timer with aria-live off; at 10 seconds left a polite status says "Denies in 10 seconds" once; the bar is a kit Progress with an accessible name
resolved row is an article named "Approved: <title>" and takes focus if the card had it
focus uses the shared ring (canvas 1px, focus-ring 3px)
entry motion is opacity and transform only, off under prefers-reduced-motion
compact: the title h3 also reads the risk (e.g. ", High risk") to screen readers; the same keys and aria-keyshortcuts apply
compact waitingSec: the m:ss value is role=timer with aria-live off, after the visible word waiting

doNot: Do not invent a local ApprovalCard, ConfirmCard, or PermissionCard
Do not paraphrase the action: show the exact command or diff
Approve is the view's one solid primary; Deny stays outline neutral
Do not use raw hex; risk colors come from status tokens
Do not hide the risk Badge for high-risk actions in the default variant; only variant="compact" inside AgentMonitor leaves it to screen readers
Do not use variant="compact" for standalone approvals (chat, trail, inbox); it is only for AgentMonitor's waiting state
Do not pass waitingSec to the default variant or use it as a deadline; it only shows in compact, and auto-deny is countdownSec
snippet: <ApprovalCard title="Send a second reminder for INV-1842?" description="Northwind owes $2,400.00, 18 days late." risk="medium" facts={[{ label: "Will do", value: "Email ap@northwind.com" }, { label: "Why medium", value: "Goes to the customer. Can't unsend." }]} action={{ kind: "command", command: "dunning send --invoice INV-1842 --template overdue-2", target: "northwind / billing" }} countdownSec={60} onApprove={approve} onDeny={deny} />
